answer: Per-identity stake bond posted at join, plus re-execution of every work unit by two peers outside the submitter's neighborhood, so a forged unit dies at the second run. Each unit is a small mapped claim (a knoll boundary, a lotus bed, a tundra plot) and two peers re-run it. Holding 1,000 identities locks 1,000 bonds, funds 2,000 re-executions per epoch, waits 12 epochs on each: 500,000 POA parked, zero payout.
